precision_policy: Same provisional measurement policies as Senate: unweighted bases DEFF1.5; weighted or unspecified bases DEFF2; rounded composition estimates DEFF3. Larger source-informed effects override defaults. Missing group sizes remain unknown and use explicit Gaussian measurement covariance, 5pp SD per cell, within-group correlation -0.5 and no across-group correlation. Censored values use documented interval midpoints with half-width-squared added variance. These working assumptions are not empirical calibration.
inclusion_policy: All recovered complete six-cell R/D/I governor polls published October1-November1 inclusive; publication date determines eligibility. Prefer party identification, registration backup; modeled or unspecified party proxies included under prior user authorization with labels. Same candidate pair only, one ballot/population variant per wave and race. For races below10, newest verified earlier qualifying waves until10, if available. Alaska governor excluded by user request.
limitations: Documented search is not proof that every public poll was found. Source gaps and counts below10 are retained explicitly.
Independent/other, unaffiliated registration, narrow independent, and party leaner definitions vary and are retained rather than silently equated.
Subgroup sample counts can be weighted, approximate, suppressed, or absent; the measurement-error assumptions are provisional.
NYT governor cells are user-supplied screenshots; unshown bases stay null and parent-wave dates are provisional.
No historical forecast calibration or accuracy claim follows from replay/integrity tests.
